column1: # Reviewed bilingual genus name table (plan §7 genus-search gate
# Maintained by David; these rows ARE the reviewed genus list. A listed genus is
# searchable by its Latin name plus label_en/label_ja/aliases (matching is
# case/diacritic-insensitive on the JS side) and ships with the leaf areas
# where it passes the research gates in pipeline/build_mesh_research.py:
# >=10 eligible genus-rank records across >=3 cells and >=3 independent
# events per area. Labels and aliases are genus-level terms only
# names one protected species — "matsutake" or "reishi" would surface the
# very areas the species-level mask hides. Where the established Japanese
# name was unsure the row was left out entirely (curated > complete).
